result.edit: The failure shows incorrect output (01 instead of 10) when processing a non-matching group (011100) at cycle 24. The issue occurs because the state machine incorrectly transitions back to sf1 from sf6 regardless of input, losing the group boundary. Changing the transition to s1 when data is 0 properly starts a new group sequence, allowing correct classification of the next group while preserving the expected output behavior for non-matching sequences.
